Dibidup Music · Drum GroovesGroove Player

Point your camera at the QR code next to any level in the book: its grooves are added to your library and stay on this device. The code on the page called The Groove Library unlocks thousands of extra grooves. Turn on Play with the band to add bass, keys, guitars and a melody that follow the groove.

Sounds: Virtuosity Drums, Black And Blue Basses, Weresax alto sax (Karoryfer), VSCO 2 CE strings, trumpet, flute and contrabass, and FreePats FSBS guitars (CC0); Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm (CC BY 3.0); Wurlitzer EP200 by Greg Sullivan (CC BY 3.0); FluidR3 organ, clavinet, vibraphone, synth, nylon guitar, steel pan, accordion, jazz guitar and marimba (MIT).
